text:
{
  "outcome": "translated",
  "clause_id": "l171_426_n020",
  "abstain_reason": null,
  "claims": [
    "C1 if an instruction cannot be fulfilled, the assistant should be explicit about that",
    "C2 when being explicit, the assistant should follow the correct refusal style",
    "C3 after being explicit, the assistant should attempt to follow the remaining instructions",
    "C4 if there is no way to proceed, the assistant may simply refuse to comply"
  ],
  "acts": [
    "be_explicit_about(I)",
    "follow_remaining(I)",
    "refuse_comply(I)"
  ],
  "concepts": [
    {
      "name": "root_authority",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "the root authority level, the highest in the authority hierarchy, assigned to Model Spec 'root' sections",
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l171_426_n020",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "assistant_definition",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "the assistant is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document",
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l171_426_n020",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "cannot_be_fulfilled",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "instruction I cannot be fulfilled by the assistant, either because it is beyond the assistant's capabilities or for another reason",
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l171_426_n020",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "explicit_about",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "the assistant states clearly that instruction I cannot be fulfilled",
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l171_426_n020",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "correct_style",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "the refusal style the document prescribes for explaining that an instruction cannot be fulfilled",
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l171_426_n020",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "remaining_instructions",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "the instructions other than I that the assistant can still follow",
      "licence": "assumed",
      "cites": null,
      "inference": "the clause says to follow 'the remaining instructions' after being explicit, so a class of instructions other than the unfulfillable one must exist",
      "toggleable": false
    },
    {
      "name": "no_way_to_proceed",
      "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "there is no way for the assistant to proceed with instruction I at all",
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l171_426_n020",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false
    }
  ],
  "ontology": [],
  "asserts": [
    {
      "read_back": "if instruction % cannot be fulfilled, the assistant should be explicit about this",
      "read_back_slots": ["I"],
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l171_426_n020",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false,
      "status": "oblige",
      "act": "be_explicit_about(I)",
      "body": "cannot_be_fulfilled(I)"
    },
    {
      "read_back": "when being explicit about %, the assistant should follow the correct refusal style",
      "read_back_slots": ["I"],
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l171_426_n020",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false,
      "status": "oblige",
      "act": "be_explicit_about(I)",
      "body": "cannot_be_fulfilled(I), correct_style(S)"
    },
    {
      "read_back": "after being explicit about %, the assistant should attempt to follow the remaining instructions",
      "read_back_slots": ["I"],
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l171_426_n020",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false,
      "status": "oblige",
      "act": "follow_remaining(I)",
      "body": "cannot_be_fulfilled(I), explicit_about(I), remaining_instructions(R)"
    },
    {
      "read_back": "if there is no way to proceed with %, the assistant may simply refuse to comply",
      "read_back_slots": ["I"],
      "licence": "textual",
      "cites": "l171_426_n020",
      "inference": null,
      "toggleable": false,
      "status": "permit",
      "act": "refuse_comply(I)",
      "body": "cannot_be_fulfilled(I), no_way_to_proceed(I)"
    }
  ],
  "beats": [],
  "defines": [],
  "closure": [
    {
      "act_class": "be_explicit_about",
      "closure": "cepa",
      "reason": "the clause obliges being explicit when an instruction cannot be fulfilled, but says nothing about being explicit in other situations, so silence permits"
    },
    {
      "act_class": "follow_remaining",
      "closure": "cepa",
      "reason": "the clause obliges attempting to follow remaining instructions only after being explicit about an unfulfillable instruction; other followings are not addressed, so silence permits"
    },
    {
      "act_class": "refuse_comply",
      "closure": "cepa",
      "reason": "the clause permits refusing to comply only when there is no way to proceed; it does not forbid refusing in other situations, so silence permits"
    }
  ],
  "requires": [
    "root_authority/1",
    "assistant_definition/1"
  ],
  "inputs": [
    "cannot_be_fulfilled/1",
    "explicit_about/1",
    "correct_style/1",
    "remaining_instructions/1",
    "no_way_to_proceed/1"
  ],
  "forbid_body": []
}
